source.note: Restates the executable knowledge-base recipes (docs/knowledge/) for schema-7 project memory. tests/knowledge_checks.py re-verifies each recipe's checks with the pinned compiler; importing this manifest re-verifies nothing and cited functions are linked only to what their retained proof artifacts establish.

lessons.title: Operand order, register choice and schedule follow declaration context, not the body
lessons.summary: When the candidate already has the target's instructions but a compare's operands are mirrored (cmp ecx,eax vs cmp eax,ecx with the opposite jcc), SIB base/index are swapped, a scratch register differs, or one independent instruction moved, CL 10.00 is choosing by internal symbol numbering. Semantic rewrites of the body (a==b vs b==a, locals, register, early return, types) do not move it; 96 such variants failed on one function.
lessons.action: Keep the body byte-for-byte. Add unused data declarations such as `extern int decl_pad_0; extern int decl_pad_1;` (1 to 16 of them; 10 and 14 were needed) before or between the existing top-level declarations, or reorder the existing declarations, and change only that between turns. Label them as compiler-state padding in a comment.
lessons.expectedEffect: The mirrored compare, swapped SIB operands or moved instruction flips to the target's form with every other byte unchanged.
lessons.limits: Only helps once the body compiles to the target's instruction multiset. Names and data types of the padding do not matter; function prototypes count differently from data declarations.
lessons.verification: Strict relocated byte comparison of the whole function through the durable queue.
caveats: Padding reproduces compiler state; it is not recovered source.
Exact bytes do not establish the original declarations or their order.

lessons.title: A different scratch register with identical instructions is the same symbol-numbering effect
lessons.summary: Candidates that differ only by register renaming or instruction order, with the same length, were fixed by unused declarations or declaration reordering rather than by body edits.
lessons.action: Keep the body. Try unused `extern int decl_pad_N;` declarations (1 to 8) at the top, then between existing declarations, then reorder existing declarations.
lessons.expectedEffect: Register assignment and schedule change as a whole; one variant reproduces the target.
lessons.limits: Semantic differences must be fixed first.
lessons.verification: Strict relocated byte comparison of the whole function through the durable queue.
caveats: Not every register difference is reachable this way; about one in seven near misses were fixed.

lessons.title: Declaring a callee before a global fixed a compare that 96 body variants could not
lessons.summary: 0042dcf0 compared its argument with a global. With the global declared before the callee's prototype the compiler loaded the global first; declaring the callee first reproduced the target exactly. In 004237c0 four globals summed in a loop loaded in the exact reverse of their declaration order; source term order was canonicalised.
lessons.action: Permute the order of the existing extern declarations (single moves first) before touching the function body.
lessons.expectedEffect: Load and compare operand order match the target.
lessons.limits: Effect is not predictable from source order; search it.
lessons.verification: Strict relocated byte comparison of the whole function through the durable queue.
caveats: Declaration order is compiler state, not recovered header content.

lessons.title: Re-read object fields through the pointer instead of caching Ghidra-style locals
lessons.summary: A velocity clamp written as Ghidra pseudocode with every field cached in a local mirrored one compare. Written as gob->yVel += gob->yAccl; if (gob->yVel > gob->maxyVel) gob->yVel = gob->maxyVel; else if (gob->yVel < -gob->maxyVel) gob->yVel = -gob->maxyVel; it matched exactly. Ghidra's GXObject layout names these members; Ghidra's GXObject** parameter type is an analysis error. The same natural rewrite fixed 004213f0, whose Ghidra goto-shaped control flow had inverted one conditional jump.
lessons.action: Declare a local struct with the members the function touches (padding elsewhere) and write the updates as compound assignments and re-reads through the object pointer.
lessons.expectedEffect: Load/compare order follows the natural expression trees of the original.
lessons.limits: Member names and types come from Ghidra and are evidence, not proof.
lessons.verification: Strict relocated byte comparison of the whole function through the durable queue.
caveats: Exact bytes do not establish member types.

lessons.title: and reg,0x80000000 before shr is not reproducible with CL 10.00 /O2
lessons.summary: The target keeps the narrow mask; CL 10.00 widens it to 0x8fffffff over bits the following shift discards. Every tried form fails: (x>>31)<<3, (x&0x80000000)>>28, division, split statements, unsigned bitfields, /O1 /Ox /G3 /G4 /Op. 31 unmatched functions contain the idiom and no exact function does.
lessons.action: Do not spend turns on this mask once the rest matches. Report the remaining difference as a toolchain limit.
lessons.expectedEffect: No change is expected under this toolchain.
lessons.limits: Likely needs the original compiler (VC++ 4.2, CL 10.20); the executable was linked by linker 4.20 on 1996-09-12.
lessons.verification: Negative search with the pinned compiler; zero proofs in the family.
caveats: Not proof that no source form exists.

lessons.title: A different stack frame size means a local aggregate of the wrong size
lessons.summary: When sub esp,N and every [esp+k] displacement differ but instructions match, Ghidra has usually split one out-parameter buffer into an array plus stray locals that the source never writes. Sizing one buffer from the frame and the lea passed to the callee fixed 00421820 exactly.
lessons.action: Replace the split locals with one buffer of the frame's size and read the fields as its elements.
lessons.expectedEffect: Frame size and all esp displacements match.
lessons.limits: Only when the instruction sequence already matches.
lessons.verification: Strict relocated byte comparison of the whole function through the durable queue.
caveats: Buffer element types are not proved by exact bytes.
